{{External|rs|dw}} {{Otheruses|the regular monster|the slayer monster|Warped Terrorbird}} {{HasTask|Birds}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = 1 |version2 = 2 |version3 = 3 |name = Terrorbird |image1 = [[File:Terrorbird.png|250x250px]] |image2 = [[File:Terrorbird (2).png|250x250px]] |image3 = [[File:Terrorbird (3).png|250x250px]] |release1 = [[29 March]] [[2004]] |release2 = [[9 July]] [[2007]] |release3 = [[9 July]] [[2007]] |update1 = RS2 Launched! |update2 = A bird in the hand... |update3 = A bird in the hand... |members = Yes |combat = 28 |size = 2 |examine = A giant raptor. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 3 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 30 |slayxp = 34 |cat = Birds |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints = 34 |att = 23 |str = 23 |def = 19 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 2064 |id2 = 2065 |id3 = 2066 }} '''Terrorbirds''' (''Aves Terror'') are animals used by the gnomes as mounts. They are found on the west side of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. They are also involved in the [[Rag and Bone Man II]] quest, where the ones that don't have any gnomes mounted upon them will drop a special bone needed for the quest.
